why: Thirty-six records in eight topic clusters, so a question about production can be answered wrongly with the staging record. Thirty questions in four bands: easy shares wording, hard is a paraphrase, adversarial has a near duplicate competing, absent has no answer and the correct behaviour is to return nothing. The absent band is the one that stops 'return everything' from scoring like a search.

records.text: The deployment key rotates on the first day of each month.
The previous deployment key is retained for thirty days so old builds can still be verified.
The signing key lives in the hardware module and never leaves it.
The root key is offline and is only used twice a year.
Postgres listens on port 5433 in the staging environment.
Postgres listens on port 5432 in production.
Read replicas lag behind the primary by less than two hundred milliseconds.
The connection pool is capped at fifty sessions across all services.
Backups are copied to the off-site bucket every night at 02:30 UTC.
Backups are retained for ninety days, and monthly snapshots for three years.
A restore is rehearsed on the first Tuesday of every quarter.
The estate runs on three hosts: throne, watchtower and pi.
Throne is the build machine and has the largest disk.
The pi is a single board computer and is only used for the always-on collector.
The nightly report is generated by the reporting worker, not by cron.
Reports are timestamped in UTC and the viewer converts to local time.
A failed replication pages the operator within five minutes.
Disk pressure above ninety percent pages the operator immediately.
Alerts can be silenced for one hour by an operator during maintenance.
The corpus holds 105 cases: 46 defects and 59 clean controls.
A clean control that the linter flags is a false positive and fails the build.
The linter completes in about a second on the certification corpus.
Windows appends must be opened with O_BINARY or carriage returns corrupt the bytes.
Git normalises line endings on checkout, which hides the carriage returns from the linter.
A memory write is acknowledged only after a byte-exact read-back.
The search index can be deleted and rebuilt from the log.
Concurrent writers serialise on an operating-system lock.
Each store is isolated by a path variable so two stores cannot see each other.
The on-call rota rotates weekly on Monday at 09:00 local time.
If the primary does not respond in fifteen minutes the secondary is paged.
The hosting budget is reviewed at the start of each quarter.
The vendor contract renews in March and has a thirty day notice period.
The runbook is owned by the platform team and reviewed every six months.
All customer data is stored in the Frankfurt region.
Personal data is redacted from logs before they are shipped.
The service aims to answer ninety five percent of requests inside two hundred milliseconds.
